recipe-section-1.markdown:
- **Bread flour**: 56 g (for Tangzhong) + 504 g (for main dough)
- **Whole milk**: 112 g (for Tangzhong) + 240 g (for main dough, warmed to 43 °C
- **Active dry yeast**: 7 g
- **Granulated sugar**: 100 g
- **Sea salt**: 6 g
- **Butter**: 250 g (softened)
- **Eggs**: 2 large
- **Neutral oil**: A splash (for coating the dough and work surface) ([**6:48**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3UdSQp_9sdI&t=408s))
recipe-section-1.html:
• Bread flour: 56 g (for Tangzhong) + 504 g (for main dough)
  • Whole milk: 112 g (for Tangzhong) + 240 g (for main dough, warmed to 43 °C
  • Active dry yeast: 7 g
  • Granulated sugar: 100 g
  • Sea salt: 6 g
  • Butter: 250 g (softened)
  • Eggs: 2 large
  • Neutral oil: A splash (for coating the dough and work surface) (6:48)
recipe-section-1.title: The Dough & Tangzhong

recipe-section-2.markdown:
- **Fresh strawberries**: 500 g (for jam) + 300 g (diced, reserved for topping) ([**8:29**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3UdSQp_9sdI&t=509s))
- **Granulated sugar**: 50 g
- **Cornstarch**: 30 g *(Aaron uses a modified amount to perfectly stabilize the juices) (*[***10:09***](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3UdSQp_9sdI&t=609s)*)*
- **Lotus Biscoff cream/spread**: 1 jar
- **Biscoff cookies**: One 250 g package
recipe-section-2.html:
• Fresh strawberries: 500 g (for jam) + 300 g (diced, reserved for topping) (8:29)
  • Granulated sugar: 50 g
  • Cornstarch: 30 g (Aaron uses a modified amount to perfectly stabilize the juices) (10:09)
  • Lotus Biscoff cream/spread: 1 jar
  • Biscoff cookies: One 250 g package
recipe-section-2.title: The Strawberry Jam & Fillings

recipe-section-3.markdown:
- **Heavy cream**: 120 g (poured over the rolls before baking)
- **Cream cheese frosting**: Leftover or fresh batch *(Aaron directs viewers to his carrot cake recipe for this) (*[***26:43***](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3UdSQp_9sdI&t=1603s)*)*
recipe-section-3.html:
• Heavy cream: 120 g (poured over the rolls before baking)
  • Cream cheese frosting: Leftover or fresh batch (Aaron directs viewers to his carrot cake recipe for this) (26:43)
recipe-section-3.title: Baking & Toppings

recipe-section-5.markdown: - On the stovetop over high heat, constantly whisk 56 g of bread flour and 112 g of whole milk together ([**0:31**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3UdSQp_9sdI&t=31s)). It will rapidly form a thick paste and pull into a cohesive ball ([**1:14**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3UdSQp_9sdI&t=74s)). Remove it from the heat and set it aside to cool ([**2:22**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3UdSQp_9sdI&t=142s)); this starter locks in moisture so the rolls stay soft for up to 8 days ([**0:56**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3UdSQp_9sdI&t=56s)).
recipe-section-5.html: • On the stovetop over high heat, constantly whisk 56 g of bread flour and 112 g of whole milk together (0:31). It will rapidly form a thick paste and pull into a cohesive ball (1:14). Remove it from the heat and set it aside to cool (2:22); this starter locks in moisture so the rolls stay soft for up to 8 days (0:56).
recipe-section-5.title: Step 1: Make the Tangzhong Starter

recipe-section-6.markdown: - Ensure your remaining 240 g of milk is at 43 °C ([**2:14**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3UdSQp_9sdI&t=134s)). Stir in 7 g of active dry yeast directly into the milk to dissolve ([**3:22**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3UdSQp_9sdI&t=202s)). In your stand mixer bowl, add 504 g of bread flour, 100 g of sugar, and 6 g of sea salt ([**2:47**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3UdSQp_9sdI&t=167s)). Pour in the yeast-milk mixture and add your prepared Tangzhong ([**0:21**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3UdSQp_9sdI&t=21s)).
recipe-section-6.html: • Ensure your remaining 240 g of milk is at 43 °C (2:14). Stir in 7 g of active dry yeast directly into the milk to dissolve (3:22). In your stand mixer bowl, add 504 g of bread flour, 100 g of sugar, and 6 g of sea salt (2:47). Pour in the yeast-milk mixture and add your prepared Tangzhong (0:21).
recipe-section-6.title: Step 2: Activate Yeast and Combine Wet Ingredients
recipe-section-6.heading_html: Step 2: Activate Yeast and Combine Wet Ingredients

recipe-section-7.markdown: - Using a stand mixer on speed 2, begin kneading the dough components ([**4:11**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3UdSQp_9sdI&t=251s)). Once the mixture begins forming a ball around the hook, add all 250 g of softened butter at once ([**4:58**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3UdSQp_9sdI&t=298s)). Crank the mixer up to speed 7 and let it knead for about 8 to 10 minutes until smooth ([**5:19**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3UdSQp_9sdI&t=319s)).
recipe-section-7.html: • Using a stand mixer on speed 2, begin kneading the dough components (4:11). Once the mixture begins forming a ball around the hook, add all 250 g of softened butter at once (4:58). Crank the mixer up to speed 7 and let it knead for about 8 to 10 minutes until smooth (5:19).
recipe-section-7.title: Step 3: Knead and Incorporate Butter

recipe-section-8.markdown: - Lightly coat the inside of a bowl with neutral oil ([**5:55**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3UdSQp_9sdI&t=355s)). Turn your kneaded dough into the bowl, flipping it so the surface is fully protected by the oil ([**6:48**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3UdSQp_9sdI&t=408s)). Cover and let it rest at room temperature for 1 to 4 hours until it has cleanly doubled in size ([**6:11**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3UdSQp_9sdI&t=371s)).
recipe-section-8.html: • Lightly coat the inside of a bowl with neutral oil (5:55). Turn your kneaded dough into the bowl, flipping it so the surface is fully protected by the oil (6:48). Cover and let it rest at room temperature for 1 to 4 hours until it has cleanly doubled in size (6:11).
recipe-section-8.title: Step 4: The First Rise

recipe-section-9.markdown: - While the dough rises, chop 500 g of strawberries and add them to a saucepan with 50 g of sugar and your cornstarch ([**8:29**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3UdSQp_9sdI&t=509s)). Smash the fruits up roughly on the stove ([**9:07**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3UdSQp_9sdI&t=547s)). Simmer until it thickens into a stable jam that won't run out of your rolls during assembly ([**10:43**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3UdSQp_9sdI&t=643s)). Set aside to cool.
recipe-section-9.html: • While the dough rises, chop 500 g of strawberries and add them to a saucepan with 50 g of sugar and your cornstarch (8:29). Smash the fruits up roughly on the stove (9:07). Simmer until it thickens into a stable jam that won't run out of your rolls during assembly (10:43). Set aside to cool.
recipe-section-9.title: Step 5: Simmer the Chunky Jam

recipe-section-10.markdown: - Punch down your risen dough to release excess gas ([**13:26**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3UdSQp_9sdI&t=806s)). Instead of using flour (which dries out the dough), slick your baking mat and rolling pin with neutral oil ([**13:53**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3UdSQp_9sdI&t=833s)). Roll the dough out carefully into a large, uniform rectangle, making sure not to roll it too thin ([**14:31**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3UdSQp_9sdI&t=871s)).
recipe-section-10.html: • Punch down your risen dough to release excess gas (13:26). Instead of using flour (which dries out the dough), slick your baking mat and rolling pin with neutral oil (13:53). Roll the dough out carefully into a large, uniform rectangle, making sure not to roll it too thin (14:31).
recipe-section-10.title: Step 6: Roll Out the Rectangular Dough
recipe-section-10.heading_html: Step 6: Roll Out the Rectangular Dough

recipe-section-11.markdown: - Warm your jar of Biscoff cream in the microwave briefly so it spreads easily ([**16:31**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3UdSQp_9sdI&t=991s)). Slather a thick, even layer of the Biscoff cream entirely across the dough rectangle ([**17:52**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3UdSQp_9sdI&t=1072s)). Spread your cooled, chunky strawberry jam right over the top ([**17:45**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3UdSQp_9sdI&t=1065s)). Use a pizza cutter to slice the dough into long, even strips ([**22:01**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3UdSQp_9sdI&t=1321s)). [[1](https://youtu.be/3UdSQp_9sdI#:~:text=The%20perfect%20way%20to%20start%20your%20day%2C,are%20the%20ultimate%20spring%20or%20summer%20treat.)]
recipe-section-11.html: • Warm your jar of Biscoff cream in the microwave briefly so it spreads easily (16:31). Slather a thick, even layer of the Biscoff cream entirely across the dough rectangle (17:52). Spread your cooled, chunky strawberry jam right over the top (17:45). Use a pizza cutter to slice the dough into long, even strips (22:01). [1]
recipe-section-11.title: Step 7: Spread the Fillings and Cut
recipe-section-11.heading_html: Step 7: Spread the Fillings and Cut

recipe-section-12.markdown: Roll each sliced strip up individually into classic swirled roll shapes and arrange them in your baking pan ([**21:48**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3UdSQp_9sdI&t=1308s)). For an extra infusion of moisture, pour 120 g of heavy cream directly over the tops of the arranged rolls ([**25:10**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3UdSQp_9sdI&t=1510s)). Allow them to puff up for their final rise.
recipe-section-12.html: Roll each sliced strip up individually into classic swirled roll shapes and arrange them in your baking pan (21:48). For an extra infusion of moisture, pour 120 g of heavy cream directly over the tops of the arranged rolls (25:10). Allow them to puff up for their final rise.
recipe-section-12.title: Step 8: Assemble and Second Rise

recipe-section-13.markdown: Preheat your oven to 190 °C ([**23:13**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3UdSQp_9sdI&t=1393s)). Slide the rolls in and bake for exactly 25 minutes until the tops are golden brown and fluffy ([**23:27**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3UdSQp_9sdI&t=1407s)).
recipe-section-13.html: Preheat your oven to 190 °C (23:13). Slide the rolls in and bake for exactly 25 minutes until the tops are golden brown and fluffy (23:27).
recipe-section-13.title: Step 9: Bake to Golden Perfection

recipe-section-14.markdown:
- **Cold cream cheese**: 440 g ([**11:23**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VHZq1E4Spnw&t=683s))
- **Butter**: 250 g (Slightly chilled, but soft enough to leave a thumbprint) ([**11:59**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VHZq1E4Spnw&t=719s))
- **Powdered sugar**: 400 g *(Adjusted down from 600 g for perfect sweetness)* ([**13:21**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VHZq1E4Spnw&t=801s))
- **Vanilla paste**: 5 mL ([**12:50**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VHZq1E4Spnw&t=770s))
- **Walnuts**: An extra generous handful (Roughly chopped for topping) ([**17:12**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VHZq1E4Spnw&t=1032s))
recipe-section-14.html:
• Cold cream cheese: 440 g (11:23)
  • Butter: 250 g (Slightly chilled, but soft enough to leave a thumbprint) (11:59)
  • Powdered sugar: 400 g (Adjusted down from 600 g for perfect sweetness) (13:21)
  • Vanilla paste: 5 mL (12:50)
  • Walnuts: An extra generous handful (Roughly chopped for topping) (17:12)
recipe-section-14.title: For the Cream Cheese Frosting & Topping
recipe-section-14.heading_html: For the Cream Cheese Frosting & Topping

recipe-section-15.markdown: Let the baked rolls cool slightly. Load up your piping bags and drizzle a heavy zigzag pattern of cream cheese frosting and extra melted Biscoff spread over the warm rolls ([**26:26**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3UdSQp_9sdI&t=1586s)). Toss your remaining 300 g of fresh diced strawberries and a heavy handful of crushed Biscoff cookie crumbles over the top before diving in ([**8:38**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3UdSQp_9sdI&t=518s)).
recipe-section-15.html: Let the baked rolls cool slightly. Load up your piping bags and drizzle a heavy zigzag pattern of cream cheese frosting and extra melted Biscoff spread over the warm rolls (26:26). Toss your remaining 300 g of fresh diced strawberries and a heavy handful of crushed Biscoff cookie crumbles over the top before diving in (8:38).
recipe-section-15.title: Step 10: Dress and Serve
